resources.string: Your support helps us keep Zerion free, private, and secure for everyone. Every contribution makes a difference.
Your nickname will be shown next to any content you post. You can\'t change it after creating your account.

Your Zerion account is stored encrypted on your device, not in the cloud. If you forget your password or uninstall Zerion, there\'s no way to recover your account.\n\nChoose a long password that\'s hard to guess, such as four random words, or ten random letters, numbers and symbols.

To run in the background, Zerion needs to be locked to the recent apps list.

Turning on this setting will make new messages in this conversation automatically disappear after 7 days. 

The countdown for the sender's copy of the message starts after it has been delivered. The countdown starts for the recipient after they have read the message. 

Messages that will disappear are marked with a bomb icon. 

Keep in mind that recipients can still make copies of the messages you send. 

If you change this setting, it will apply to your new messages immediately and to your contact's messages once they receive your next message. Your contact can also change this setting for the both of you.

If you can\'t connect to your contact via the Internet, Zerion can also transfer messages on a removable drive such as a USB stick or an SD card.

If you can't connect to your contact via the Internet, Zerion can also transfer messages on a removable drive such as a USB stick or an SD card.

When you use the "Send Data" button, any data that's waiting to be sent to the contact will be written to the removable drive. This includes private messages, attachments and private groups.

Everything will be encrypted before it is written to the removable drive.

When your contact receives the removable drive, they can use the "Receive Data" button to import the messages into Zerion.
